rules.rule: An explicitly person-directed name, description or pronoun can supply person presence when it serves the request. Resolving the individual identity or supplying a proper name is not required. Grammatical first/second person merely addressing the assistant does not by itself establish a task participant; a role such as contact owner, recipient or queried subject must be expressed.
rules.boundary: Bare ambiguous it/they without a supported human role remains unresolved; no person label inferred solely from creator world knowledge.

rules.rule: personal_info requires an explicitly requested or stated contact/person attribute, such as a phone number field or work department. The communication medium email and a standalone mailbox identifying expression do not on their own add a second personal_info predicate.
rules.boundary: An explicit field and an explicit value can coexist. Absence is established by full-input review, not by native email_address membership.

rules.rule: house_place includes a domestic room, area or household surface used as a cleaning/activity target. place_name requires a geographic location, venue or travel destination role; a bare household surface as a cleaning target does not satisfy it.
rules.boundary: A home or room explicitly used as a destination can support a location role; no global house_place implies not place_name rule.

rules.rule: ingredient includes an explicitly stated material/component/substitute used in food preparation, including the material acted upon by an explicitly requested cooking process. A food name or request for a recipe alone does not certify an input role. food_type may also be true when its food/dish definition is satisfied.
rules.boundary: The object of cook/steam/poach can be an ingredient even without naming another finished dish. Recipe-for wording alone may remain ambiguous; no blanket negative or lexical food list.

rules.rule: radio_name requires a station/channel/tuning reference, which can be descriptive rather than a proper name. An application/service name does not automatically identify a station.
rules.boundary: Service/station ambiguity without a disambiguating role remains unresolved; do not force both true or use native omission as false.

integration: Explicit rule overlay for seven re-reviewed proposals; not silently applied to other old reviews or canonical task.

support.support_scope: All 16 native-positive ingredient learning sources read; this is not all semantic ingredient sources or negative certification.

release_requirements: Incorporate role rules into final type definitions and shared rules before task freeze.
Full-population annotation under same version; independent disagreement review.
No training or metric feedback from unadmitted proposals.
